Our preference is DocuSign for this workflow because our automation (webhook + audit ingestion) attaches the signed PDFs and the certificate directly to the deal record.

Plan proposal: 
- Redwood sends DocuSign envelope to Fintegrate signers in the order you specify.
- Once all Fintegrate signers complete, Redwood's authorized sig (as listed in the signatory matrix) will countersign.
- We'll include the SCCs and the final DPA PDF as separate documents within the envelope so they appear in the signed bundle.

Timeline: we will prepare the envelope today if you confirm signers; target send by Wed 4/4 EOD ET and we can enable ID check + timestamping. If you still require AdobeSign we can support but countersign may be manual (adds ~1 business day).

Attaching our latest redlines for visibility.
